text: The NFMIP is notable for its $100 million ERF-backed capital injection focused exclusively on flood mitigation infrastructure. It aligns with the Disaster Recovery Funding Arrangements (DRFA) to reduce future eligible expenditure and improve insurance outcomes. The program's governance is supported by bilateral schedules under the Federal Financial Relations framework, ensuring legal clarity and intergovernmental cooperation. Localized prioritization allowed state agencies to engage councils in identifying and submitting locally-led priorities.
